entities.name: Ora Kedem
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ora Kedem was an Austrian-born Israeli chemist who was a professor at the Weizmann Institute of Science and Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, and a recipient of the 1961 Israel Prize for life sciences.
